content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is strong and purposeful, but the radiator illustration is cut off at the bottom and the hero runs long before any proof of the trade.","desktopNote":"Desktop header wastes a full band on an oversized wordmark and lone 'Domov' link, and the footer repeats the brand name twice with contact details already shown in the CTA block above.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Shrink the desktop header: small wordmark left, nav right, remove the lone 'Domov' link and the second divider so the hero starts higher.","Merge the dark 'Pokličite nas za ogled' block and footer: show address, phone and 'Navodila za pot' once, drop the repeated giant brand name and second 'Inštalacije Rebernik' line.","Add a real job photo (boiler room, bathroom) next to the radiator illustration and tighten the 'Kje delamo' desktop timeline so labels sit close to the dots with less dead space below."],"blockers":["Desktop 'Kje delamo': the town labels are cut off from the timeline dots, with a large empty band beneath them.","Phone and desktop footer: the brand name appears twice in a row and the address/phone repeat the contact block directly above."]}
